We had several negotiation meetings because I wanted to ensure I selected the right company for my project. How much have you invested with them?I've spent around $60,000 on this project, and I'll spend more on marketing expenses. What is the status of this engagement? I started discussions with TekRevol in January 2024.

I like that the team can provide what I need for this project.How did TekRevol perform from a project management standpoint?TekRevol is very organized. Most of the time, I contact my project management team, and if there is something I think they can't address, I contact Ryan, who has been super responsive. I'm very happy with TekRevol. I like that the team always resolves issues and ensures I'm satisfied as a customer. The team does everything they can to deliver a good product and has corrected things I wasn't satisfied with from their initial presentation. TekRevol is very professional and seems genuinely invested in the success of my product. In the long run, if I'm successful, I'll most likely go back to TekRevol to build another app, recommend them, or hire them to maintain the app. The team is very invested in helping customers do well, not only from a business standpoint.Are there any areas they could improve?I can't think of anything TekRevol can improve. When I wasn't happy with the app's direction, I expressed it to TekRevol, and they assigned me a new project management team. The new project manager overhauled the project's entire idea and is a good listener, making the project according to my envisioning. I don't have constructive feedback because TekRevol is doing everything right. Do you have any advice for future clients of theirs?I suggest ensuring you understand what you're trying to develop so you can covey it as detailed as possible to TekRevol. Engaging with TekRevol on a weekly basis is helpful because you'll be informed about the project and will not find any surprises.
